description:
A simple portrait pack, made from concept art and game assets from different IPs, edited into one grounded package that hopefully remains compatible with the vanilla aesthetic.

No AI Generation. Just as Brother Cotton intended.

Download Here

Repo Here

No art was made by me, all credit to the original artists. All I did was cobble some cool looking art into portraits. I used GIMP to edit everything. This is my first mod for well, anything actually.

1.1.0 Release

- Now 45 Portraits, added mostly from Dead Space and Cyberpunk, up from 26
- Edited existing portraits to look better
- New naming conventions for better sorting and future-proofing
- Standardised faction seperation for better continuity and additional future-proofing
- Version Checker enabled correctly for TriOS, etc.

Shoutout to Chozo's Battletech Portrait pack for being the inspiration as well as Vexlia Artemiss for their advice.

Previous changelogs:

Spoiler
1.0.0

Current selection of a measley 26 new portraits with plenty of ideas to expand. Future plans are to separate portraits between low / med / high tech aligned factions when there's more bulk e.g. more Highfleet-esq style for Pirate & Pathers, MENACE & Titanfall for Heg & Persean, so on and so forth. This way, the more diverse styles can still flourish in their respective themes as well as some simple thematic recolours.

discordPostHtml:
A simple portrait pack, made from concept art and game assets from different IPs, edited into one grounded package that hopefully remains compatible with the vanilla aesthetic.

https://github.com/ThunderCTA/Grounded-Portrait-Pack/releases/download/TheBin/Current.Selection.2.png
No art was made by me, all credit to the original artists. All I did was cobble some cool looking art into portraits. I used GIMP to edit everything.

Added a massively streamlined process for adding new material, figured out how Version Checker works (I hope), added more portraits and edited the existing ones to look better. Added pack design post to forums for detailed changes.

Changelog - 1.1.0

  • Now 45 Portraits, added mostly from Dead Space and Cyberpunk, up from 26
  • Edited existing portraits to look better
  • New naming conventions for better sorting and future-proofing
  • Standardised faction seperation for better continuity and additional future-proofing
  • Version Checker enabled correctly for TriOS, etc.

Special thanks to Vexlia Artemiss for their kind words as well as Chozo being the inspiration with their Battletech Portrait Pack.

Forum Link: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=34833
Download Here: https://github.com/ThunderCTA/Grounded-Portrait-Pack/releases/download/Starsector/Grounded.Portraits.Pack.1.0.0.zip
aiDescription: Replaces character portraits with a curated selection of concept art and game assets from various IPs. The pack is edited to maintain a grounded aesthetic that fits the vanilla game style. It includes 45 portraits organized by tech level and gender presentation to match faction demographics.
